source_binding.source_move_rate_role: movement-speed target for MoveScale, not direct clip fps

hierarchy.validation: complete base hierarchy and every base/motion track, not only mesh ancestors
hierarchy.outer_root_btt: zero for both roots; original invalid outer parent skips accumulation
hierarchy.reference_bone_order: ascending global id among all 60 reachable nodes
hierarchy.reference_matrix_order: 3 rows x 4 columns, affine rows as uploaded to shader

sampling.motion_rotation: source short-arc normalized linear interpolation, not SLERP
sampling.motion_position: source key sampling/interpolation followed by animDelta subtraction
sampling.anim_delta: first attached animation position minus first sequencer base position
sampling.missing_motion_track: base initial position and raw base quaternion held fixed by GFXNODE_DONTANIMATE
sampling.cycle_rule: advance float32 frame; if frame>last subtract last-first once; if still frame>last reset first

math.btt: root totals zero; each other bone gets parent btt + first sequencer-base local position
math.shader_translation: unchanged qualified Phase6 GLSL ES3 source-semantic shader

oracle.local_samples: retained original-function host oracle over original raw animation keys
oracle.hierarchy_palette: independent Python binary64 implementation, serialized float32
oracle.skin: independent scalar source-GPU arithmetic using serialized float32 palette

objective_gates.raw_container: native validates original Win32-layout base and motion tracks and complete hierarchy bounds before sampling
objective_gates.local_sampler: native C against retained original-function decoded/interpolated local values at integer, fractional and endpoint frames
objective_gates.hierarchy: native local/world/btt/bpt/socket palette against independent full60-bone reference
objective_gates.gpu_transform: all116 vertices, six position+normal components, absolute error<=1e-4
objective_gates.gpu_image: GPU skin against independently prepared vertex geometry, useful interior RGBA error<=2 byte units
objective_gates.time_variation: different source times produce changing mesh positions and image; runtime preview samples raw keys on device
objective_gates.clock_boundaries: last retained, fractional wrap, one-subtraction large-step reset
objective_gates.lifecycle: context destruction/recreation and window presentation repeated using the runtime sampler
objective_gates.material_regression: retain all18 qualified Phase6 material, alpha, fog and blend cases

excluded_from_claim: full sequencer state machine, MoveScale/SmoothSprint, footfall FX
Wretch actor GeomScale1.3, bone morphs, shoulder/neck/hip proportions
full costume part assembly or costume texture overrides
live Windows animation/palette capture or original Cg bit-for-bit parity
whole game functionality, networking, audio or performance promises
